verdict.rationale: The only bulk-import capability documented is a case import API for batch-creating cases. That is a different object type from customer and transaction records. Nothing in the evidence describes tracking import job status or resuming after a partial failure, and the developer docs are password-gated, so these capabilities cannot be verified.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track bulk customer and transaction imports and resume after partial failure

citations.quote: Hummingbird also supports batch creating cases over the case import API.
